game.rules:
### As of March 9th 2025, the Jak leaderboards will no longer be accepting Twitch VODs as submission proof. Please submit your run as a YouTube video.

Making use of the following will **invalidate a run without exceptions**:

- Disc tray manipulation
- Any form of speeding-up the runtime of the game
    - via Progressive Scan
    - any possible future methods (e.g. gameshark, or modified software/hardware)
- Unofficial emulations (ie. PCSX2)
    - This does not include the official PS4/PS5 versions
- Enabling developer tools of any form (aka *Debug Mode*), this includes:
    - via Controller Inputs
    - via Emulator through ELF editing
    - any possible future methods (e.g. gameshark, or modified software/hardware)
- Save states and/or the rewind feature on PS4/PS5

**Please start runs correctly.** If you are unsure, please check [*this guide*.](https://www.speedrun.com/jak1/guide/j1t2s) If you are still unsure, message a moderator, or ask in the [*Discord server*.](https://discord.gg/W9dJ5EePde)

Making use of these is **permitted**:

- Playing from an SSD for the HD collection or on PS4/PS5

categories.name: No Major Skips
categories.rules:
## Objective
Beat the game as fast as possible.  You may not perform any _major skips_.
These are performed if:
* You bypass the power cell requirement of an area (20 for Fire Canyon, 45 for Klaww, 72 for Lava Tube).
* You skip any "required" cell to beat the game (any cells that are not intended to possibly be skipped).
* You abuse any checkpoint bugs (e.g. Citadel Skip, idle deloads).
* You skip any boss that the developers intended to be required for game completion (e.g. Klaww and final boss). The plant boss does not fall into this category because it can be skipped in casual play.

Additionally, you're not allowed to skip the first and last cutscenes in Gol and Maia's Citadel. This category is meant to be equally competitive for all platforms, and checkpoints in Citadel work differently across them.

## Timing
### Start
http://www.speedrun.com/jak1/guide/j1t2s

### End
Upon starting the ending cutscene and beating the game.
> At the time of writing, this typically refers to collecting the light eco at the final boss.

**Note:** When submitting runs, please do not include milliseconds in your time. That slot exists solely for Dead Man's Gorge submissions.

**Debug mode is not allowed.**

categories.name: No LTS
categories.rules:
## Objective

Beat the game as fast as possible.
*Lava Tube Skip (LTS)* is banned.
No additional restrictions on glitches, skips, etc.

## Timing

### Start

http://www.speedrun.com/jak1/guide/j1t2s

### End

Upon **touching light eco** in the Final Boss and beating the game.

> Time ends specifically on the **first frame** of the ending cutscene.
> *(In the rare case of a crash due to touching two light eco at once, time ends 1 frame after this crash occurs)*

**Note:** When submitting runs, please do not include milliseconds in your time. That slot exists solely for Dead Man's Gorge submissions.

**Debug mode is not allowed.**

## Objective

Obtain all collectables in the game and defeat the final boss to reach 100% completion. This includes:

- 101 Power Cells
- 2000 Precursor Orbs
- 112 Scout Flies

Orb duplication is not allowed.
No additional restrictions on glitches, skips, etc.

## Timing

### Start

http://www.speedrun.com/jak1/guide/j1t2s

### End

Upon **touching light eco** in the Final Boss and beating the game or **collecting the last collectable**, whichever comes ***last***. 

> Time ends specifically on the first frame of the ending cutscene, or on the first frame that the collectable has been touched.
> *In the rare case of a crash due to touching two light eco at once, time ends 1 frame after this crash occurs.*

**Note:** When submitting runs, please do not include milliseconds in your time. That slot exists solely for Dead Man's Gorge submissions.

**Debug mode is not allowed.**

categories.name: All Power Cells
categories.rules:
## Objective
Collect all Power Cells and finish any task that would get you a cell in the hub world (you do not have to actually go back to the hub and get the cell).

**You are not allowed to alter anything inside of the level itself before starting the run** (ex. breaking any box, killing enemies, advancing any cell goal, etc.).  
You can, however, have things from another level done which unlock certain elements (ex. zoomers, Flut Flut, eco vents).

## Timing
### Start
Upon gaining control of Jak from loading a save on the first checkpoint of said level (with the exception of Geyser Rock).
> It is recommended you measure the amount of time it takes to load the save. Then, you can [_add that delay to LiveSplit_](https://www.speedrun.com/jak1/guide/j1t2s) (scroll to the bottom of the guide) and start the timer when you select the file to load.

### End
Upon starting the cutscene of the last Power Cell or finishing the last task necessary.

**Debug mode is not allowed.**

categories.name: Orbless
categories.rules:
## Objective

Beat the game as fast as possible without collecting any Precursor Orbs.
*Lava Tube Skip (LTS)* is banned.
No additional restrictions on glitches, skips, etc.

## Timing

### Start

http://www.speedrun.com/jak1/guide/j1t2s

### End

Upon **touching light eco** in the Final Boss and beating the game.

> Time ends specifically on the **first frame** of the ending cutscene.
> *(In the rare case of a crash due to touching two light eco at once, time ends 1 frame after this crash occurs)*

**Note:**

- If you collect an orb during the run, you are allowed to load a previous save that was made during the run and has 0 total orbs collected. Otherwise, you must reset.
- For versions that cannot perform [*Citadel Skip*](https://www.speedrun.com/jak1/guide/bxd2y), you will need to do [*Citadel Skip v2*](https://www.speedrun.com/jak1/guide/e6l27), as the intended route for the level cannot be done without orbs.
- When submitting runs, please do not include milliseconds in your time. That slot exists solely for Dead Man's Gorge submissions.

**Debug mode is not allowed.**
